title: Grant Thornton BusinessTools Design System
intro: A professional, accessible, and adaptive component system based on native Apple HIG aesthetics, combining official Grant Thornton brand colors with optimized guidelines for web applications and PDF/Mailing exports.

primary.name: GT Purple
primary.usage: Primary brand color for main buttons (CTAs), active states, and key interactive elements across the platform.

secondary.name: Accent Cyan
secondary.usage: Secondary accent color for text links, secondary buttons, active navigation, and supporting actions.

gold.name: Accent Red / Warning
gold.usage: Warning notices, critical attention calls, and highlighting tax penalties.

background.name: Grouped Light Background
background.usage: General grouped background behind cards and portal elements to provide visual depth (iOS style).

card.name: White Surface
card.usage: Elevated card surfaces, data forms, and text inputs floating over the gray background.

text.name: On-Surface Dark
text.usage: Primary text with high readability on light screens.

textMuted.name: Neutral Gray
textMuted.usage: Subtitles, secondary labels, disabled icons, and input borders.

success.name: Success Green
success.usage: Indicators for completed tax compliance without errors and successful processes.

error.name: System Error Red
error.usage: Error states in validations and destructive system actions.

primary.family: Inter & SF Pro Text (Google Fonts / Apple Native)

hierarchy.name: Large Title
hierarchy.usage: Primary titles for panels and compliance dashboards.

hierarchy.name: Body Text
hierarchy.usage: General reading text and tax explanations using the Apple typographic scale.

hierarchy.name: Subhead / Labels
hierarchy.usage: Form labels, text fields, and secondary table information.

hierarchy.name: Caption
hierarchy.usage: Complementary information and legal footnotes at the bottom of reports.
